title: Morning Brief — Thursday, 15 October 2026
description: Real wages fall for a third straight quarter despite July's minimum wage rise, Queensland's largest solar and battery project near Townsville targets 2028 operation, and Gold Coast employers keep struggling to fill roles even as job ad volumes ease. 한국어 방송도 이어집니다.
